description: Evaluation suite (tasks 5.1 + 5.2): pin and introspect strands-agents-evals, synthetic scenario/knowledge/adversarial datasets, a scenario weather provider, deterministic metrics, offline runner (part of pytest), opt-in live runner (Bedrock Nova + LLM judge via strands_evals OutputEvaluator + knowledge test), a CLI, and the generated results JSON + docs/evaluation.md from real runs in this session. Plan items 1-6 and decisions D-M5-1..8 in d:\github work\SDK workshop\.agents\tasks\heatwise-m5\plan.md (read that plan's Decisions and items 1-6 for full detail). First FEAT; FEAT-002 reads the results file schema defined here.
steps: Item 1: add "strands-agents-evals==1.8.0" to pyproject.toml [project.optional-dependencies].dev and a new `eval = ["strands-agents-evals==1.8.0"]`; run `uv pip install --python .venv\Scripts\python.exe -e ".[dev]"`; confirm strands-agents stays 1.63.0. Introspect the INSTALLED package (dir/__all__, inspect.signature of Case, Experiment, Experiment.run_evaluations, strands_evals.evaluators.OutputEvaluator.__init__ incl. the judge model parameter name and accepted type, the returned report's attributes, strands_evals.types.TaskOutput, sync vs async). Record the verified names in this FEAT's findings and later in tasks.md; use installed names even if they differ from the workshop notebook (_reference/strands-workshop/samples/07-evals/module-07-evals.ipynb).

Item 2: create backend/evaluation/datasets/scenarios-v1.json (18 synthetic scenarios S01-S18 as listed in plan item 2, each with location, forecast_days 3, profile, weather fixture incl. injected errors/missing/staleness, expected {status, risk_category, verification_status, path}, derivation, tags; label everything synthetic; keep values >= 1 F / 0.5 C from band edges), knowledge-test-v1.json (10 MCQs q01-q10 tied to CATALOG item ids with min_category low, source_ids, answer_evidence substring; no medicine/dose/phone in options), adversarial-v1.json (9 unsafe injections + 3 safe controls). Create backend/evaluation/dataset.py (pydantic models + load_scenarios/load_knowledge_test/load_adversarial, utf-8). Create backend/tests/test_evaluation_dataset.py including an INDEPENDENT re-typed design.md 8.2 implementation (bands 80/90/103/125 F, IMD 40/45/47 C on plains/null terrain, hazard=max, +1 step at >=2 indicators when hazard>=1, cap extreme; only risk_rules.heat_index_f reused) that must reproduce every expected risk_category.

Item 3: create backend/evaluation/provider.py ScenarioWeatherProvider(scenarios, stale_after_minutes) implementing backend.services.weather.base.WeatherProvider (geocode first comma part casefolded; current/forecast/alerts with alerts_supported=False; provider 'HeatWise evaluation fixtures (synthetic)', source_url 'synthetic://heatwise/evaluation', data_mode 'demo'; missing_fields for nulls; is_stale via base.is_stale; injected errors raise ProviderUnavailableError/ProviderTimeoutError/LocationNotFoundError; records calls). Add `provider: WeatherProvider | None = None` to build_offline_coordinator in backend/agents/offline.py (default unchanged). Tests in backend/tests/test_evaluation_harness.py.

Item 4: create backend/evaluation/metrics.py (weather_extraction per-field within 0.05, risk_agreement, source_verification, safety_pass, workflow_completion, delegation_order effective + model-driven over report.trace successful coordinator/coordinator_fallback entries in step_index order, timing mean/median/max; each metric {value, numerator, denominator, unit, mode, status, note}), backend/evaluation/adversarial.py (run_direct_cases via run_checks on a real plan + one injected PlanItem; run_end_to_end with a planner ScriptedModel calling add_general_advice unsafe text twice, re-declared here, not imported from backend/tests), backend/evaluation/results.py (RunResult, EvaluationResults, DEFAULT_RESULTS_PATH = backend/evaluation/results/evaluation-results.json, load_results, save_run replacing only that mode's section with an atomic write), backend/evaluation/runner.py run_offline() (Settings(_env_file=None, weather_provider='demo', agent_mode='offline'); fresh build_offline_coordinator(..., provider=ScenarioWeatherProvider) per scenario; perf_counter timing; per-scenario rows; failures with examples; relevance and knowledge test status not_run 'live only'). Tests in backend/tests/test_evaluation_harness.py (results only in tmp_path).

Item 5: create backend/evaluation/live.py (MeteredBedrockModel(BedrockModel) summing metadata.usage tokens from stream events; run_live(settings, scenario_ids, judge, answerer) using HeatWiseCoordinator(settings, weather_agent=WeatherIntelligenceAgent(settings, provider=scenario provider, model=metered), model=metered); raw reports to .data/evaluation/live-<timestamp>/), backend/evaluation/judge.py (strands_evals relevance judge with Case/Experiment/OutputEvaluator on stored outputs, judge model = settings.bedrock_model_id via the verified parameter; bedrock_knowledge_answerer with Agent(structured_output_model=KnowledgeTestAnswers flat q01..q10, structured_output_attempts 2); lazy imports; docstring records the verified strands_evals API), backend/evaluation/report.py render_markdown(results) (synthetic banner, reproduce commands, methodology, dataset, per-metric table WITH a Mode column, failures with examples, knowledge test framed as 'LLM in test scenarios, not people', tokens/cost note, limitations), backend/evaluation/__main__.py CLI (`run --mode offline`, `run --mode live --confirm-live [--scenarios ...] [--knowledge ...] [--max-scenarios N]` with refusal without --confirm-live and hard cap 6, `report [--results] [--out docs/evaluation.md]`). Tests in backend/tests/test_evaluation_live.py with fakes only (no Bedrock).

Item 6: run `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m backend.evaluation run --mode offline` then `... report`; read-only credential check (`aws sts get-caller-identity`, AWS MCP preferred); run live ONCE: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m backend.evaluation run --mode live --confirm-live --scenarios S01,S04,S08,S14 --knowledge S01,S04` (us-east-1, us.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0); try to fetch the Nova 2 Lite on-demand price from https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/pricing/ (else 'price not verified', tokens only); run `report` again. If live fails, record the error in runs.live and let the report say so. Never edit generated numbers by hand. Re-running `report` must leave docs/evaluation.md unchanged.

Schema (pydantic EvaluationResults): {schema_version: 'heatwise-eval-results-v1', synthetic: true, label: str, runs: {offline: RunResult|null, live: RunResult|null}}. RunResult: {mode: 'offline'|'live', mode_label: str, status: 'ok'|'failed', error: str|null, command, started_at (ISO UTC), finished_at, dataset_version, settings{...}, scenario_ids[], metrics{key: Metric}, scenarios[per-scenario rows: id, title, tags, expected, actual{status,risk_category,verification_status,revision_count,plan_language,requested_language}, checks{}, weather_fields{matched,total,mismatches}, sources{items,trusted_sources,verified}, delegation{actual_path,effective,model_driven,fallback_used,steering_blocks,finalized_by_model}, duration_ms, provider_calls, report_id, error], adversarial{direct{...}, end_to_end{...}}|null, relevance{evaluator, overall_score, cases[{case_id,score,test_pass,reason}], error}|null, knowledge_test{dataset_version, framing, rows[{scenario_id, items_in_plan{qid:bool}, baseline{error,correct,total,per_question}, with_checklist{...}}]}|null, usage{inputTokens,outputTokens,totalTokens,calls, judge{...}, knowledge_test{...}}|null, cost{price_verified:false, note}|null, failures[{scenario_id, metric, detail}], raw_reports_dir}. Metric: {value: float 0-1 (or ms for timing_ms)|null, numerator, denominator, unit, mode: 'offline'|'live', status: 'measured'|'not_run', note, details{}}.
